subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this PR wait for retained live Discord proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source-level evidence plus the unretained canary observation for this focused failed-progress suppression?
rationale: The code shape appears focused, but the changed behavior is channel-visible message delivery and the existing proof does not retain the after-fix Discord path or fallback-warning behavior.

options.title: Require retained Discord proof
options.body: Refresh the branch and require a redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level evidence
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally land the focused filter while accepting the missing retained live Discord proof.

options.title: Pause until proof is practical
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked if neither the contributor nor a maintainer can capture the Discord path yet.

recommendation.title: Require retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and require a redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord progress preview work makes vincentkoc the strongest routing candidate for deciding whether source-level proof is enough for this channel path.
